content: BswModuleEntity attributes for sender-receiver data exchange The attributes BswModuleEntity . dataSendPoint and BswModuleEn- tity . dataReceivePoint specify, that this BswModuleEntity has access to the BSW Scheduler in order to send resp. receive the data declared in the referred Vari- ableDataPrototype . This is targeted at inter-partition and/or multicore communica- tion scenarios. 2
